gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-sauras: Almendra Display carries an ornate, literary tone, with letters that stay open and a pronounced x-height. Noto Sans Saurashtra stays clean beneath it.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC reads modern, with chalky curves that stop short of closing. Audiowide is best at tubing-bent, futuristic display lettering, whereas Noto Sans SC does its best work in the plain sans text below.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-sharad: Open c forms that never close into rings give Noto Sans Sharada a clean, bulky lowercase. Almendra Display sits above it with ornate, literary letters, so the page moves from decorative to direct.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Approachable and contemporary, Noto Sans Siddham fills its text line with a large central band and a loosely hung s. Audiowide's tile-like, futuristic letters make the contrast unmistakable.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-sinhal: Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, steady and professional. And Almendra Display, ornate and literary, gives that dense texture a graceful, open-lettered lead-in.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-sundan: Noto Sans Sundanese reads clean, its e crossbars open and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Noto Sans Sundanese can go a touch larger on screen, since Almendra Display already stands out.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar opens with approachable curves that leave daylight inside, and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Audiowide, bent like a paperclip, then hands over to text that moves smoothly.
